title: Investigation of the Interplay Between Local Oral Inflammation, Microbiota and Systemic Immune Responses.
official: Investigation of the Interplay Between Local Oral Inflammation, Microbiota and Systemic Immune Responses.
summary: This is a clinical research study designed to measure changes in inflammation and the oral microbiome during a phase of good oral hygiene and the absence of oral hygiene. The goal of the study is to investigate the interplay between local oral inflammation, microbiota and systemic immune responses.
